native_retrieval.title: Openers, Mahedi And Rishad Help Bangladesh Keep Series Alive - Telecom Asia Sport
native_retrieval.snippet: # Openers, Mahedi And Rishad Help Bangladesh Keep Series Alive. Saif Hassan and Tanzid Hasan laid the platform before Mohammad Saifuddin's late onslaught and a spin squeeze sealed a 34-run win to level the series. Bangladesh kept the three-match T20I series alive with a commanding 34-run victory over Zimbabwe in Bulawayo, setting up a winner-takes-all decider. Their innings had two contrasting halves: a record opening stand of 120 between Saif Hassan and Tanzid Hasan, followed by a dramatic collapse, before Mohammad Saifuddin's extraordinary final-over assault lifted them to 186 for 5. Mahedi Hasan and Rishad Hossain dominated the middle overs, sharing seven wickets as Bangladesh bowled the hosts out for 152. Sikandar Raza broke the opening stand by bowling Saif, Richard Ngarava removed Tanzid and Towhid Hridoy in quick succession, and Brad Evans dismissed Parvez Hossain Emon and Nurul Hasan as Bangladesh lost five wickets for just 21 runs. 1.Openers Cash In On Zimbabwe's Generosity2.Collapse Checks Bangladesh Before Saifuddin Explodes3.Mahedi And Rishad Choke Zimbabwe4.Burl Fights, But Zimbabwe Fall Short.

native_retrieval.title: After a bear mauled him, Sitesh Ranjan Deb became a rescuer of Bangladesh’s wildlife - Butler Nature
native_retrieval.snippet: # After a bear mauled him, Sitesh Ranjan Deb became a rescuer of Bangladesh’s wildlife. * Post author    By Rhett Ayers Butler. The bear came out of the forest with enough force to kill him. During three months in a hospital, he began asking why he was hunting and killing animals. His father and grandfather were known around Sreemangal, in northeastern Bangladesh, for killing leopards, wild boars, and other animals that threatened people or crops. As a boy, Sitesh Ranjan Deb accompanied his father into the forest. The grounds of his home became a treatment center and eventually developed into the Bangladesh Wildlife Service Foundation. When a call came, he collected the animal, found room for it at home, obtained the food it needed, and worked toward the day when its cage could be carried back to the forest and opened. **Sitesh Ranjan Deb turned a hunter’s knowledge to saving wildlife**.

native_retrieval.title: Bepza Economic Zone in Mirsarai draws nearly $130m before completion, eyes $2.9b potential - The Business Standard
native_retrieval.snippet: # Bepza Economic Zone in Mirsarai draws nearly $130m before completion, eyes $2.9b potential. * *Bepza Economic Zone attracted $130 million investment before project completion*. **Bepza Economic Zone in Mirsarai, Chittagong, had attracted $130 million in investment as of mid-July – even before the site's development project was completed – generating $52.82 million in exports and creating jobs for 5,074 Bangladeshi citizens, according to the Bangladesh Export Processing Zones Authority (Bepza).**. On 16 July, Chinese company Huarun Tex Co Ltd signed a land lease agreement with Bepza authorities to invest $30 million in a textile manufacturing plant in the Bepza EZ. With this, at least 63 local and foreign companies had signed lease agreements to invest in the zone, with proposed investment totalling $1.49 billion, Bepza data showed. Kaixi Lingerie Bangladesh is the zone's largest exporter and employer, with an investment of $18.91 million, cumulative exports of $34.56 million and a workforce of 3,651 Bangladeshis – more than half of the zone's total employment.

native_retrieval.title: It's Official: A Legendary Honda Tuner Was Bought By Private Equity - Motor1.com
native_retrieval.snippet: # It's Official: A Legendary Honda Tuner Was Bought By Private Equity. ## The company that already owns Cobb Tuning, PRL, and AutoMeter has acquired Hondata, as confirmed to Motor1. * **Engineered Performance Technologies Group acquired Hondata in May.**. * **Hondata offers Honda and Acura owners the ability to tune their engine control units.**. * **Engineered Performance Technologies Group already owns Cobb Tuning, PRL, and AutoMeter.**. Hondata, a company that offers Honda and Acura owners the ability to tune their engine control units, has been acquired by Engineered Performance Technologies (EPT) Group. EPT has since confirmed to *Motor1* that Hondata joined the group in May. In a press release shared with *Motor1* announcing the acquisition, Hondata will now have the resources to "accelerate technological leadership," expand customer support, and "bring even more innovations" to the marketplace. **Motor1’s Take:** EPT's acquisition of Hondata will give the aftermarket tuner a much-needed boost in resources, enabling it to continue serving its customers.

english_retrieval.title: Jharkhand govt to launch model agriculture villages and panchayats - The Times of India
english_retrieval.snippet: Ranchi: The Jharkhand govt would design model agriculture villages and panchayats across the state to ensure targeted implementation of welfare schemes based on local requirements rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.Reviewing the agriculture department’s plans, chief minister (CM) Hemant Soren on Friday directed the department to identify villages or panchayats in every district for the initiative and conduct detailed surveys to assess the needs of farmers before rolling out govt programmes/ welfare schemes.He stressed the need for direct engagement with farmers and addressing key infrastructure gaps, including soil testing facilities and irrigation systems. “Govt interventions should be guided by ground realities to maximise benefits for the farming community,” he said.Talking to STOI, agriculture minister Shilpi Neha Tirkey said, “The project aims to create clusters of villages, where farming, fisheries or animal husbandry schemes can be implemented in a coordinated manner after assessing local needs instead of randomly applying schemes so that the maximum number of people are benefitted.”The pilot project will initially focus on areas with large tracts of fallow or uncultivated land.

The Resurrection Creek Restoration Project is healing a century-old environmental scar near Hope, Alaska, by bringing together traditionally opposing forces—including conservation groups, federal agencies, and active mining companies—united by a shared love of salmon. So, in 2022, Trout Unlimited, Kinross Alaska, Hope Mining Company, National Forest Foundation, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association, and the Forest Service came together for the Resurrection Creek Restoration Project to fund the river’s habitat resurrection. Marzullo’s team of Forest Service engineers, hydrologists, fish biologists, and contracted construction workers have worked for four years to change the river’s water flow from one straight riffle to a riffle, pool, glide and floodplain that support salmon eggs and young.

english_retrieval.title: Arkansas agriculture department opens applications for free student fruit and vegetable program - K8 News | Jonesboro, Arkansas
english_retrieval.snippet: # Arkansas agriculture department opens applications for free student fruit and vegetable program. (KAIT) - The Arkansas Department of Agriculture is accepting applications from state elementary schools for the 2026-27 USDA Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Program. Beginning Oct. 1, the department will administer $3,376,009 in program funding for schools to purchase fresh fruits and vegetables to serve free to students in grades K-6. “The Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Program gives Arkansas students greater access to healthy foods during the school day while helping them develop lifelong healthy eating habits,” said Stephanie Alsbrook, Arkansas Department of Agriculture’s food and nutrition director. “For too long, students lacked the fuel they needed to learn, but thanks to the USDA Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Program, schools are now able to make sure that Arkansas’ students have access to the healthy, nutritious foods they deserve right in their school cafeterias,” Sanders said. Schools that participate in the National School Lunch Program are eligible to apply.

english_retrieval.title: Hiker injured in brown bear attack in Alaska - USA Today
english_retrieval.snippet: # Hiker injured in brown bear attack in Alaska. A brown bear in Alaska recently injured a woman while on a hike, local authorities say. On Saturday, July 18, the Anchorage Police Department, Anchorage Fire Department, Alaska State Troopers and Alaska Department of Fish and Game responded to a bear incident on a trail in Anchorage's Bear Valley. A woman was transported to a local hospital after sustaining non-life-threatening injuries during the encounter, according to an Anchorage Police Department news release. The group encountered the bear on a narrow, switch-back trail in an area with low visibility, according to an Alaska Department of Fish and Game news release. At the time of the rescue, Anchorage police deployed a drone to monitor for bear activity in the area, according to the department's news release. Brown and black bears are reported in Bear Valley each year, hence the name, according to the Alaska Department of Fish and Game.
